scope: The ocean_ruin templates as Top-Down places them, the processor lists the pieces use, and each structure's decoration step and index. Built by audit/seed-map-topdown/u12-villages/build/village_top.py from the official server jar.
encoding: columns: base64 of per-column records [x u8, z u8, n u8, n x (y u8, palette index u16 LE)], blocks from the top down to the first block that blocks motion whatever a rule makes of it, then on while they touch (every block when a block_rot list places the template); containers: base64 of [x u8, y u8, z u8] per RandomizableContainer block entity, sorted; template-local, unrotated; processors: rule or block_rot; every block of each template but its air; markers: per template, its DATA structure blocks [x, y, z, metadata], template-local
